###### Effect size correlations

```{r, Effect Size Correlations - All DVs}

# Correlate effect sizes between DVs

conditions <- c("Correcting Misperceptions", "Distrust Salience", "Dynamic Norms", "Escalating Commitment",
                "Implementation Intentions", "Interdependent Construal", "Moral Reasons", "Personal Importance", 
                "Self-Generated Norms", "System Justification")

# Function to clean up results 
clean_results <- function(df, outcome_name) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      Variable = str_trim(Variable),
      d = as.numeric(d) # Make sure standardized d numeric 
    ) %>%
    filter(Variable %in% conditions) %>% # Only keep conditions
    transmute(Intervention = Variable,
              Outcome = outcome_name,
              d)
}

# Apply to each table (tables from 6. VR_Analyses_Primary_DVs)
intent_tbl <- clean_results(Intentions_Model_1_Results$appendix, "Intentions")
Intentions_Model_1_Results$appendix
intent_tbl

link_tbl <- clean_results(Link_Model_1_Results$appendix, "Link")
Link_Model_1_Results$appendix
link_tbl 

reg_tbl <- clean_results(Registration_Model_1_Results$appendix,"Registration")
Registration_Model_1_Results$appendix
reg_tbl

vote_tbl <- clean_results(Vote_Model_1_Results$appendix,"Voting")
Vote_Model_1_Results$appendix
vote_tbl

trust_tbl <- clean_results(TrustAgg_Model_1_Results$appendix,"Trust")
TrustAgg_Model_1_Results$appendix
trust_tbl

efficacy_tbl <- clean_results(Efficacy_Model_1_Results$appendix,"Efficacy")
Efficacy_Model_1_Results$appendix
efficacy_tbl

norms_tbl <- clean_results(Norms_Model_1_Results$appendix,"Norms")
Norms_Model_1_Results$appendix
norms_tbl

# Merge results 
all_ds <- bind_rows(intent_tbl, link_tbl, reg_tbl, vote_tbl, trust_tbl, efficacy_tbl, norms_tbl) # Long format

# Make wide 
all_ds_wide <- all_ds %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Outcome, values_from = d)

all_ds_wide

# Correlation matrix
d_mat <- all_ds_wide %>%  # Create data frame with just numbers 
  dplyr::select(-Intervention) %>% 
  as.data.frame()

cor_mat  <- cor(d_mat, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
p_mat <- cor_pmat(d_mat)

# Blank upper triangle 
cor_mat[upper.tri(cor_mat)] <- NA
p_mat[upper.tri(p_mat)] <- NA

# Significance stars
get_stars <- function(p) {
  ifelse(is.na(p), "", 
         ifelse(p < 0.001, "***", 
         ifelse(p < 0.01, "**", 
         ifelse(p < 0.05, "*", ""))))
}

# Format correlations (round, remove leading 0s, add stars)
formatted_cor <- matrix("", nrow = nrow(cor_mat), ncol = ncol(cor_mat),
                        dimnames = dimnames(cor_mat))

for (i in 1:nrow(cor_mat)) {
  for (j in 1:ncol(cor_mat)) {
    val <- cor_mat[i, j]
    if (!is.na(val)) {
      stars <- get_stars(p_mat[i, j])
      val_fmt <- sprintf("%.2f", val)
      val_fmt <- sub("^-0\\.", "-.", val_fmt)   # remove leading 0 
      val_fmt <- sub("^0\\.", ".", val_fmt)     
      formatted_cor[i, j] <- paste0(val_fmt, stars)
    }
  }
}

formatted_cor

# Visualize 
pdf(
  "EffectSizeCorrs.pdf",
  width = 7,
  height = 7,
  version = "1.4",
  useDingbats = FALSE
)

corrplot(
  cor_mat,
  method = "circle",
  type = "lower",
  addCoef.col = "black",
  title = "Effect Size Correlations Across All Dependent Measures",
  mar = c(0, 0, 1, 0),
  number.cex = 0.8,
  number.digits = 2
)

dev.off()

```

###### Candidate Preference

```{r, Candidate Preference With Covariates Two-Tailed}

# Filter dataset to include only those who would vote
df_candidate <- df %>% 
  mutate(vote_today = as.character(vote_today)) %>%
  filter(vote_today %in% c("Donald Trump", "Kamala Harris"))

nrow(df_candidate) # 8403

zdf_candidate <- zdf %>% 
  mutate(vote_today = as.character(vote_today)) %>%
  filter(vote_today %in% c("Donald Trump", "Kamala Harris"))

nrow(zdf_candidate) # 8403

# Make sure the reference level is set to the control condition
df_candidate$condition <- relevel(as.factor(df_candidate$condition), ref = "ControlCondition")
table(df_candidate$condition)

zdf_candidate$condition <- relevel(as.factor(zdf_candidate$condition), ref = "ControlCondition")
table(zdf_candidate$condition)

# Fit the model
Preference_Model_1 <- lm(vote_today_bin ~ condition, data = df_candidate)
summary(Preference_Model_1)

Preference_Model_1_robust <- coeftest(Preference_Model_1, vcov = vcovHC(Preference_Model_1, type = "HC3"))
Preference_Model_1_robust

Preference_Model_1_Stand <- lm(vote_today_bin ~ condition, data = zdf_candidate)
summary(Preference_Model_1_Stand)

# Use two tailed lm function to format
Preference_Model_1_Results <- format_lm_output_twotailed(Preference_Model_1_robust, Preference_Model_1_Stand)

# Outputs:
Preference_Model_1_Results$appendix   # Cleaned and formatted for LaTeX

print.xtable(Preference_Model_1_Results$appendix_xtable, include.rownames = FALSE) # Syntax for latex editor

```

###### Readability + Word Length

```{r, Build a corpus and compute readability}

# Read in intervention text
Interventions <- read.xlsx("InterventionTEXT.xlsx")

# Edit slightly for merging
Interventions <- Interventions %>%
  rename(Intervention = condition) %>%
  mutate(
    Intervention = dplyr::recode(Intervention, !!!variable_labels) # Use variable labels
  )

view(Interventions)

# Add word count
Interventions <- Interventions %>%
  mutate(word_count = stringr::str_count(text, "\\S+"))

# Build a corpus (docnames = intervention labels)
corp <- corpus(Interventions$text, docnames = Interventions$Intervention)

# 3) Compute readability metrics
# - "Flesch" is Reading Ease (higher = easier)
# - "Flesch.Kincaid" is grade level (higher = harder)
read_df <- textstat_readability(
  corp,
  measure = c("Flesch", "Flesch.Kincaid")
) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  rename(
    Intervention = document,
    flesch_reading_ease = Flesch,
    flesch_kincaid_grade = Flesch.Kincaid
  ) %>%
  left_join(Interventions %>% dplyr::select(Intervention, word_count), by = "Intervention") %>%
  arrange(Intervention)

# Round (only for latex table)
# read_df$flesch_reading_ease<-clean_round(read_df$flesch_reading_ease)
# read_df$flesch_kincaid_grade<-clean_round(read_df$flesch_kincaid_grade)

view(read_df)

# LateX
align_spec <- c("l","l","r", "r", "r")
read_df_xtable <- xtable(read_df, align = align_spec, booktabs = T)
colnames(read_df_xtable)[colnames(read_df_xtable) == "flesch_reading_ease"] <- "Flesch Reading Ease"
colnames(read_df_xtable)[colnames(read_df_xtable) == "flesch_kincaid_grade"] <- "Flesch Kincaid Grade"
colnames(read_df_xtable)[colnames(read_df_xtable) == "word_count"] <- "Word Count"
  
# Print appendix
print.xtable(read_df_xtable, include.rownames = FALSE, sanitize.colnames.function = identity, sanitize.text.function = identity, floating = FALSE)

# Range (without control)
read_df %>%
  filter(Intervention != "Control Condition") %>%
  pull(flesch_kincaid_grade) %>%
  round(2) %>%
  range()
# 5.72-11.99

# Median (without control)
read_df %>%
  filter(Intervention != "Control Condition") %>%
  pull(flesch_kincaid_grade) %>%
  median() %>%
  round(2)
# 9.47

```

# Function to get results from models
extract_coefs <- function(model, var_name) {
  s <- summary(model)
  coefs <- s$coefficients
  
  b <- coefs[var_name, "Estimate"]
  se <- coefs[var_name, "Std. Error"]
  p <- coefs[var_name, "Pr(>|t|)"]
  
  star <- ifelse(p < .001, "***",
           ifelse(p < .01, "**",
           ifelse(p < .05, "*", "")))
  
  paste0(clean_round(b), " (", clean_round(se), ")", star)
}


# Build table
readability_table <- data.frame(
  Outcome = c("Intentions", "Link Clicks", "Registration", "Voting", "Trust", "Efficacy", "Norms"),
  
  # Ease models
  Ease_Readability = c(
    extract_coefs(ReadEase_Intentions, "flesch_reading_ease"),
    extract_coefs(ReadEase_LinkClicks, "flesch_reading_ease"),
    extract_coefs(ReadEase_Registration, "flesch_reading_ease"),
    extract_coefs(ReadEase_Vote, "flesch_reading_ease"),
    extract_coefs(ReadEase_Trust, "flesch_reading_ease"),
    extract_coefs(ReadEase_Efficacy, "flesch_reading_ease"),
    extract_coefs(ReadEase_Norms, "flesch_reading_ease")
  ),
  
  Ease_WordCount = c(
    extract_coefs(ReadEase_Intentions, "word_count"),
    extract_coefs(ReadEase_LinkClicks, "word_count"),
    extract_coefs(ReadEase_Registration, "word_count"),
    extract_coefs(ReadEase_Vote, "word_count"),
    extract_coefs(ReadEase_Trust, "word_count"),
    extract_coefs(ReadEase_Efficacy, "word_count"),
    extract_coefs(ReadEase_Norms, "word_count")
  ),
  
  # Grade models
  Grade_Readability = c(
    extract_coefs(ReadGrade_Intentions, "flesch_kincaid_grade"),
    extract_coefs(ReadGrade_LinkClicks, "flesch_kincaid_grade"),
    extract_coefs(ReadGrade_Registration, "flesch_kincaid_grade"),
    extract_coefs(ReadGrade_Vote, "flesch_kincaid_grade"),
    extract_coefs(ReadGrade_Trust, "flesch_kincaid_grade"),
    extract_coefs(ReadGrade_Efficacy, "flesch_kincaid_grade"),
    extract_coefs(ReadGrade_Norms, "flesch_kincaid_grade")
  ),

    extract_coefs(ReadGrade_Trust, "word_count"),
